verification_report.summary: The corollary and its proof are correct, conditional exactly on thm:big-reference-one-sided-stability as an already proved input with the stated eta-uniform constant. Applying that theorem in both orientations yields the uniform Cauchy property on Omega before any limit equation is used. The L1 limit has the canonical theta-psh representative and inherits the global sandwich across the analytic pole set. For any weak Lp density subsequence, local uniform convergence and a fixed-quadratic finite Bedford--Taylor expansion handle the smooth nonclosed background; non-pluripolarity then extends the measure identity globally. Every weak density cluster point is consequently the same Radon--Nikodym density of the fixed limit potential, without using uniqueness of potentials. Classical qpsh L1 precompactness plus this closedness gives sequential compactness, hence compactness, in d_Omega(u,v)=sup_Omega|u-v|. No metric BMP or positive lower mass enters. The preceding stability theorem and its Dang26 attribution were not independently audited in this run.
